subs.label: Chinese-Language Drama
subs.axis: Axis: by genre tradition, costume and mythic genres first (epic, palace, intrigue, case, romance, time travel, wuxia, xianxia, xuanhuan, shenmo), then the Republican and state genres, then modern romance traditions, TVB last

leaves.label: Historical Epic Drama
leaves.defn: A serial that dramatises recorded dynastic history or a classic of Chinese literature at epic scale, statecraft and great events foremost and invented romance secondary (Romance of the Three Kingdoms, The Qin Empire, Ming Dynasty in 1566, A Dream of Red Mansions). A fictional court with romantic leads goes to B4-5; schemers in a fictional court go to B4-3.
leaves.aliases: lishi zhengju (orthodox historical drama); classic-novel adaptation
leaves.see: B4-3 Court Intrigue Drama; A8 Historical & Period Film

leaves.label: Palace Drama
leaves.defn: A costume serial whose engine is the rivalry of consorts, empresses and palace women in the imperial harem, rising through scheming and survival (Empresses in the Palace, Story of Yanxi Palace, Ruyi's Royal Love in the Palace, Legend of Mi Yue). Male ministers and princes plotting for the throne go to B4-3.
leaves.see: B4-3 Court Intrigue Drama; B4-5 Costume Romance; B4-21 TVB Drama

leaves.label: Court Intrigue Drama
leaves.defn: A costume serial driven by political scheming for power, succession or revenge at court, with a strategist hero at its centre (Nirvana in Fire, The Advisors Alliance, Joy of Life, The Longest Day in Chang'an). Harem rivalry among women goes to B4-2; romance first goes to B4-5.
leaves.see: B4-2 Palace Drama; B4-1 Historical Epic Drama

leaves.label: Gong'an & Costume Detective Drama
leaves.defn: A costume serial built on cases solved by a magistrate, coroner or detective in imperial China, one or several cases per arc (Justice Bao, The Imperial Coroner, Strange Tales of Tang Dynasty, Luoyang). A jianghu swordsman solving mysteries goes to B4-7.
leaves.aliases: gong'an fiction; costume mystery; ancient detective drama
leaves.see: B4-3 Court Intrigue Drama; B7 Crime & Thriller Series

leaves.label: Costume Romance
leaves.defn: A guzhuang serial set in imperial or invented dynastic China whose engine is the central love story, intrigue and history serving it (Love Like the Galaxy: Part 1, The Story of Ming Lan, Blossoms in Adversity, Dawn Is Breaking). Immortals and cultivation go to B4-8; a modern heroine thrown into the past goes to B4-6.
leaves.aliases: guzhuang yanqing ju; costume drama; period romance
leaves.see: B4-2 Palace Drama; B4-6 Time-Travel Drama; B4-8 Xianxia Drama
leaves.axis: by the engine of the love story: court romance, household rivalry, rebirth and revenge, the general and the frontier, the heroine's enterprise, comedy last

leaves.label: Time-Travel Drama
leaves.defn: A serial whose premise is a protagonist displaced in time or into a fictional world, the gap between eras or texts being the engine (Scarlet Heart, Go Princess, Go!, Romance of a Twin Flower, Back to Seventeen). Supernatural lovers without displacement go to B4-20.
leaves.aliases: chuanyue (crossing over); chuanshu (transmigration into a book); time-slip
leaves.see: B4-5 Costume Romance; B4-20 Romantic Fantasy Drama
leaves.axis: by where the traveller lands: inside a novel or game, the dynastic past, a younger self in modern times

leaves.label: Wuxia Drama
leaves.defn: A serial of martial heroes in the jianghu, the world of sects, swordsmen and codes of honour, with martial skill realistic rather than magical (The Legend of the Condor Heroes, Laughing in the Wind, Legend of Fei, Mysterious Lotus Casebook). Immortals and cultivation go to B4-8.
leaves.see: B4-8 Xianxia Drama; A7 Action & Martial Arts
leaves.axis: by source: Jin Yong canon first, other classic authors, jianghu romance, original wuxia adventure last

leaves.label: Xianxia Drama
leaves.defn: A serial of immortals, gods, demons and cultivators in a Daoist-mythic cosmos, often across several lifetimes (Eternal Love, Ashes of Love, Love between Fairy and Devil, Till the End of the Moon). Secondary-world empires without Daoist cosmology go to B4-9; the Journey-to-the-West mythology goes to B4-10.
leaves.see: B4-9 Xuanhuan Drama; B4-10 Shenmo Drama; B5-11 Danmei Drama
leaves.axis: by engine: immortal romance across lives, cultivation and sect adventure, demon and spirit romance, comedy last

leaves.label: Xuanhuan Drama
leaves.defn: A serial set in an invented secondary world of magic, races and empires, high fantasy not bound to Daoist cosmology (Novoland: Eagle Flag, Ice Fantasy, Ever Night, Douluo Continent). Immortals and heavens go to B4-8.
leaves.see: B4-8 Xianxia Drama; B9 Speculative Series

leaves.label: Shenmo Drama
leaves.defn: A serial adapting the gods-and-demons classics and folk legends of China (Journey to the West, Feng Shen Bang, The Legend of White Snake, Butterfly Lovers). Original immortal romances go to B4-8.
leaves.see: B4-8 Xianxia Drama

leaves.label: Republican-Era Drama
leaves.defn: A serial set in the Republic of China (1912–1949) whose engine is the period itself: warlords, Shanghai glamour, opera troupes and adventure (Winter Begonia, The Mystic Nine, Siege in Fog, White Deer Plain). Spies of the period go to B4-12.
leaves.see: B4-12 Spy Drama; B4-13 Main-Melody Drama
leaves.axis: by engine: literary saga, romance, mystery and adventure

leaves.label: Spy Drama
leaves.defn: A serial of undercover agents in the Republican and anti-Japanese war years, the double life and its unmasking the engine (Lurk, Rookie Agent Rouge, All Quiet in Peking, Silent Honor). A war-front epic goes to B4-13.
leaves.see: B4-11 Republican-Era Drama; B4-13 Main-Melody Drama; B7 Crime & Thriller Series

leaves.label: Main-Melody Drama
leaves.defn: A state-endorsed serial celebrating the Party, the revolution, the army or a national achievement (Awakening Age, Minning Town, Across the Yalu River, Ace Troops). Spies go to B4-12; Republican romance goes to B4-11.
leaves.see: B4-12 Spy Drama; B4-1 Historical Epic Drama
leaves.axis: by subject: revolutionary history and leaders, war, the army today, reform and national achievement

leaves.label: Qiong Yao Drama
leaves.defn: A serial adapted from or produced by the novelist Qiong Yao, the canon of tearful romance and its comic costume offshoots (Princess Pearl, Romance in the Rain, Love in the Rain). Later Taiwanese idol drama goes to B4-15.
leaves.see: B4-15 Taiwanese Idol Drama

leaves.label: Taiwanese Idol Drama
leaves.defn: A Taiwanese romance serial of the idol-drama tradition, young pop-star leads in a glossy love story often adapted from manga (Meteor Garden, It Started with a Kiss, Hana Kimi, In Time with You). Taiwanese BL goes to B5-9.
leaves.see: B4-16 Idol Drama; B2 Korean Drama; B3 Japanese Television Drama
leaves.axis: by engine, idol era first: manga and remake idol drama, romantic comedy, melodrama, idol fantasy, post-idol romance last

leaves.label: Idol Drama
leaves.defn: A mainland romance serial of the idol-drama mode, young leads in a sweet, low-conflict love story (Well-Intended Love, Boss & Me, Hello Mr. Right). Adult workplace and marriage dramas go to B4-17; school settings go to B4-18.
leaves.aliases: ouxiang ju; tianchong (sweet pet drama); C-drama romance
leaves.see: B4-15 Taiwanese Idol Drama; B4-17 Urban Romance Drama; B4-18 Youth Drama
leaves.axis: by premise: pure sweet romance first, the domineering CEO, contract and hidden identity, entertainment industry

leaves.label: Urban Romance Drama
leaves.defn: A mainland serial of adult lives in the city, love bound up with career, profession, marriage or family (The Rational Life, You Are My Hero, Best Choice Ever, Love in the Edge of Divorce). Young sweet romance goes to B4-16.
leaves.aliases: dushi qinggan ju (urban emotional drama); urban drama
leaves.see: B4-16 Idol Drama; B1 Drama Series
leaves.axis: by the second engine beside love: the office, a profession, marriage and family

leaves.label: Youth Drama
leaves.defn: A mainland coming-of-age serial of school or university years, first love and friendship before adulthood (A Love So Beautiful, With You, When I Fly Towards You, Hidden Love). Sports-team stories go to B4-19.
leaves.see: B4-16 Idol Drama; B4-19 Sports & Esports Drama
leaves.axis: by setting: high school, college

leaves.label: Sports & Esports Drama
leaves.defn: A serial whose engine is competition in a sport or a video game, romance and rivalry riding on training and tournaments (The Whirlwind Girl, Skate Into Love, Gank Your Heart, Love O2O). Campus life without competition goes to B4-18.
leaves.see: B4-18 Youth Drama; B4-16 Idol Drama
leaves.axis: by arena: physical sport, esports and online gaming

leaves.label: Romantic Fantasy Drama
leaves.defn: A modern-day mainland romance with one supernatural element, a spirit, alien, mermaid or curse, at its centre (My Girlfriend Is an Alien, I Cannot Hug You, The Fox's Summer, Love Me in Three Days). Displacement in time goes to B4-6; immortals in mythic worlds go to B4-8.
leaves.see: B4-6 Time-Travel Drama; B9 Speculative Series

leaves.label: TVB Drama
leaves.defn: A Hong Kong serial in the house tradition of Television Broadcasts Limited, the 20-to-30-episode Cantonese drama of cops, professionals and family empires (Line Walker, Forensic Heroes, Moonlight Resonance, War and Beauty). TVB wuxia goes to B4-7.
leaves.aliases: Hong Kong drama; HK drama; Cantonese drama
leaves.see: B4-7 Wuxia Drama; B7 Crime & Thriller Series
leaves.axis: by house genre: police and crime, professional drama, family and business saga, costume drama, supernatural and comedy last

subs.label: Boys' Love & Girls' Love Drama
subs.axis: Axis: by national tradition, Thai BL subdivided by its narrative engine, GL last

leaves.label: Thai Campus BL
leaves.defn: A Thai BL (Y series) love story set among students, the faculty, the hazing senior and the dorm its stage (SOTUS, 2gether, Bad Buddy, I Told Sunset about You). Thai BL among working adults goes to B5-2.
leaves.aliases: Y series; Thai university BL; campus BL
leaves.see: B5-2 Thai Workplace & Adult BL; B5-8 Korean BL Drama
leaves.axis: by school level: university first, high school, campus sports and bands

leaves.label: Thai Workplace & Adult BL
leaves.defn: A Thai BL series about working adults, love tied to the office, a profession, showbiz, a shop or a contract (Lovely Writer, Step by Step, Moonlight Chicken, Last Twilight). Students go to B5-1; gangsters go to B5-3.
leaves.see: B5-1 Thai Campus BL; B5-7 Japanese BL Drama
leaves.axis: by the world the lovers work in: office, profession, showbiz and creative work, food and shop, contract and fake relationship, adult romance last

leaves.label: Mafia & Action BL
leaves.defn: A Thai BL series built on gangs, bodyguards, mafia families or fighters, violence and loyalty driving the romance (KinnPorsche, Never Let Me Go, The Heart Killers, Not Me). Murder mysteries go to B5-4.
leaves.see: B5-4 BL Thriller & Horror; B7 Crime & Thriller Series

leaves.label: BL Thriller & Horror
leaves.defn: A Thai BL series whose engine is a murder case, a killer or a horror, the romance inside a suspense plot (Manner of Death, Dead Friend Forever - DFF, Khemjira, The Effect). Ghost romance without dread goes to B5-5.
leaves.see: B5-3 Mafia & Action BL; B7 Crime & Thriller Series

leaves.label: Fantasy & Period BL
leaves.defn: A Thai BL series with a supernatural, time-crossing or historical premise (Until We Meet Again, Be My Favorite, Love in the Moonlight, OMG! Vampire). Horror goes to B5-4.
leaves.see: B5-4 BL Thriller & Horror; B9 Speculative Series
leaves.axis: by premise: ghosts and the supernatural, time and reincarnation, period and royal settings, creatures and omegaverse

leaves.label: Japanese BL Drama
leaves.defn: A Japanese boys' love television drama, usually a late-night adaptation of BL manga (Ossan's Love, Cherry Magic! Thirty Years of Virginity Can Make You a Wizard?!, My Beautiful Man, What Did You Eat Yesterday?). Japanese GL goes to B5-11.
leaves.see: B3 Japanese Television Drama; B5-11 GL Series
leaves.axis: by setting: office and adult life first, school and youth, fantasy, BL parody, yakuza and crime last

leaves.label: Korean BL Drama
leaves.defn: A Korean boys' love series, mostly short web-born drama adapted from webtoons and web novels (Semantic Error, To My Star, Light on Me, Painter of the Night). Korean GL goes to B5-11.
leaves.see: B2 Korean Drama; B5-6 Japanese BL Drama
leaves.axis: by setting: school and campus first, office and adult life, fantasy, sageuk last

leaves.label: Taiwanese & Hong Kong BL
leaves.defn: A boys' love series from Taiwan, Hong Kong or Singapore, the HIStory anthologies and their successors (HIStory, We Best Love: No. 1 For You, Kiseki: Dear to Me, I'm a Fool for You). Mainland danmei goes to B5-10.
leaves.see: B5-10 Danmei Drama; B4-15 Taiwanese Idol Drama
leaves.axis: by tradition and engine: Taiwanese campus BL, Taiwanese adult romance, queer family and literary drama, Hong Kong BL, Singapore BL

leaves.label: Filipino BL
leaves.defn: A Philippine boys' love series, the Pinoy BL wave that began with the lockdown productions of 2020 (Gameboys, Hello Stranger, Gameboys 2, Love at First Spike). Filipino GL goes to B5-11.
leaves.see: B5-1 Thai Campus BL
leaves.axis: by production wave: the 2020–21 lockdown wave, later Pinoy BL

leaves.label: Danmei Drama
leaves.defn: A mainland Chinese drama from the danmei tradition, uncensored early web BL or censored 'bromance' adaptations of danmei novels (Addicted, The Untamed, Word of Honor, Guardian). Taiwanese BL goes to B5-8.
leaves.see: B4-7 Wuxia Drama; B4-8 Xianxia Drama
leaves.axis: by period and censorship: uncensored web BL, censored danmei adaptation, later modern-day BL

leaves.label: GL Series
leaves.defn: A girls' love series, a romance between women in the GL/yuri tradition (GAP, Blank, Ayaka Is in Love with Hiroko!, Lulu). Mixed BL and GL anthologies stay with their BL tradition.
leaves.see: B5-1 Thai Campus BL; B5-6 Japanese BL Drama
leaves.axis: by tradition: Thai GL, Japanese GL, other GL traditions

subs.label: Lakorn
subs.axis: Axis: by lakorn genre: melodrama, comedy, period and fantasy, remake, teen series

leaves.label: Nam Nao Lakorn
leaves.defn: A prime-time Thai melodrama of passion, rivalry and revenge, often with the forced 'slap-kiss' romance (Sawan Biang, Leh Ratree, Game Sanaeha, So Wayree). Comic romance goes to B6-2.
leaves.aliases: lakorn nam nao ("rotten water"); lakorn tob jub (slap-kiss); revenge lakorn
leaves.see: B6-2 Romantic Comedy Lakorn; B12 Serial Drama Traditions

leaves.label: Romantic Comedy Lakorn
leaves.defn: A Thai romance serial played for comedy, bickering couples and contrived arrangements (Love at First Hate, Boy for Rent, My Husband in Law, My Secret Bride). Melodrama goes to B6-1.
leaves.see: B6-1 Nam Nao Lakorn; B6-5 Thai Teen Drama

leaves.label: Period & Fantasy Lakorn
leaves.defn: A lakorn with a period setting or a supernatural premise, ghosts, time-slip or magic (Love Destiny, Happy Birthday, My Cherie Amour, 55:15 Never Too Late). Thai BL with such premises goes to B5-5.
leaves.aliases: lakorn boran; lakorn phi (ghost lakorn); jak-jak wong-wong
leaves.see: B6-4 Thai Remake Drama; B5-5 Fantasy & Period BL

leaves.label: Thai Remake Drama
leaves.defn: A Thai serial remaking a Korean, Taiwanese, Chinese or Japanese drama (Full House, F4 Thailand: Boys over Flowers, Princess Hours, Kiss Me). Original lakorn go to B6-1 to B6-3.
leaves.see: B2 Korean Drama; B4-15 Taiwanese Idol Drama

leaves.label: Thai Teen Drama
leaves.defn: A Thai series of teenagers and students, school, sport and first love, mostly from GMMTV and GTH (Hormones, U-Prince: Brian, Project S: Skate Our Souls, Kiss). Teen BL goes to B5-1.
leaves.see: B5-1 Thai Campus BL; B10 Children's Series
